metadata.description: Open-source Claude plugins for DTC media buyers

plugins.name: dtc-google-ads-playbook
plugins.description: A comprehensive Google Ads playbook for DTC brands, codifying proven strategies from high-performing PMax-heavy accounts into reusable frameworks for campaign architecture, daily optimization, and ad copy creation.

plugins.name: dtc-research-engine
plugins.description: Fetches real customer voice data from public sources (Reddit, Amazon, Trustpilot, forums) and transforms it into customer personas, selling angles, ad scripts, and ad copy for DTC products.
